newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Mothercare says to open Czech outlet.
newsitem.headline: Mothercare says to open Czech outlet.

text.p: British children's wear retailer Mothercare said on Friday that it was in the final stages of negotiations with a partner to open its first outlet in the Czech capital of Prague.
"I can confirm that we are in final negotiations with a potential partner," Mothercare International said in a statement.
The statement added that the deal could be finalised on January 24.
Mothercare, a wholly owned subsidiary of Britain's Storehouse Plc, would join Marks & Spencers and Tesco as the latest British retailer to open in the Czech Republic.
Storehouse which also owns Bhs stores, is working to merge its Childrens World acquisition with Mothercare in order to increase margins.
Overseas, the group has opened its first Bhs franchise in Moscow and expects to have 200 international franchises for Bhs and Mothercare by the end of the year.
